translation: Original text of the Shennong Bencao Jing [本經]: The blue, red, yellow, white and black stone fats [石脂], flavor sweet, neutral. They mainly treat jaundice [黃膽], diarrhea and dysentery with intestinal pi [腸癖] and pus and blood, erosive downflow of red and white blood, and the five stone fats each follow their five colors,
